description: Baseline harness crashed: subprocess stdout includes scenario output (e.g., help/plain text), so JSON parsing of entire stdout failed. Switched parser to read last non-empty line as JSON payload.
Fixed first_help scenario to pass required run_cli(fetch=...) argument after baseline failed with TypeError for missing positional fetch.

Established import-surface baseline harness with fresh-process scenarios (core/root/first-use) and secondary module+allocation metrics. Benchmark runs cleanly; correctness gate currently fails on pre-existing formatting issue in src/painted/search.py.

Set up import-surface autoresearch harness and baseline: fresh child-process timings for core import, root imports, and first-use show/help paths with module-count and peak-allocation secondary metrics.

Make painted root exports fully lazy (including core primitives and cursor/viewport) so package import does not eagerly load renderer modules. Improves core_import_ms while preserving all scenarios to avoid overfitting.

Reduced import-time setup overhead in painted.__init__ by replacing many _register_lazy function calls with a static lazy-import mapping and binding import_module once. Improved cold import while preserving full scenario scorecard.
